questions.label: (i)
questions.title: Two triangles with the same area
questions.prompt:
A triangle has sides $5$ and $8$ enclosing an angle $\theta$, and its area is $10\sqrt3$.

Find the two possible values of $\theta$.
hints: Sine is positive for acute and obtuse angles.

traps.why: Missed the obtuse angle with the same sine.

questions.label: (ii)
questions.title: Two triangles with the same area
questions.prompt:
A triangle has sides $5$ and $8$ enclosing an angle $\theta$, and its area is $10\sqrt3$.

Find the two possible exact lengths of the third side.
hints: Use the cosine rule for each angle.

questions.title: Angles in ratio
questions.prompt: The angles of a triangle are in the ratio $1:2:3$ and its longest side is $10$ cm. Find the exact lengths of the other two sides.
hints: Use exact values of sin 30° and sin 60°.

traps.why: The longest side is the hypotenuse; the other sides are shorter.

questions.title: Boat below a cliff
questions.prompt: From the top of a cliff $80$ m high, the angle of depression of a boat is $25^\circ$. How far is the boat from the base of the cliff, to the nearest metre?
hints: Angle of depression equals angle of elevation.
The cliff is opposite the angle.

steps.d: The angle of elevation from the boat is $25^\circ$.

traps.why: Multiplied by tan 25° instead of dividing.
